title: Online information processing method, device, equipment and medium based on federated learning

pse.problem: Limitation in returning user feature data in prior art leads to decreased positioning accuracy of potential target groups and efficiency of resource promotion
pse.solution_function: Online information processing method based on federated learning predicts conversion rates for resource requests using a preset conversion evaluation model, determining potential target group and/or real-time bidding data accordingly
pse.solution_structure: The solution includes a conversion evaluation model, back-end conversion evaluation model, prediction model to be trained, first prediction sub-model to be trained, federation process, and federation sub-processes
pse.solution_implementation: Upon receiving a resource request, resource feature data is extracted. The resource characteristic data and local user traffic data are input into the conversion evaluation model to obtain the predicted conversion rate. The conversion evaluation model is based on preset traffic conversion data obtained by iteratively training the prediction model. The federated process includes a back-end conversion evaluation model, which is obtained by iteratively training the first prediction sub-model using preset traffic back-end transformation data
pse.effect: Improved positioning accuracy of potential target groups and efficiency of resource promotion
